scope: EndOfMonthlyContentNotification: one page, twelve TMP memberships in two six-layer groups.
context: Russian TFOL0.45. Male player Rascal is addressed informally as ty. Approved critter=zverushka; Gossip conversation system=Besedy, not rumours. Source means all content prepared SO FAR, not full-game completion; preserve permission to keep exploring, interacting and gossiping, and both built-in bug reporting entry points (main menu and pause menu). Plain friendly game prose, concise. Only title initial size22 markup retained. Normalize anomalous bare CR paragraph separators to LF. No fabricated controls. Review every listed source/target ID, including identical glow copies. Screenshot is pre-fix and not runtime evidence for target.

rows.source:
You've seen all the content we have prepared so far! Feel free to keep exploring and interacting/gossiping with the critters! 

Please report any bugs through our built in bug report tool in the Start Menu and Pause Menu.
rows.target:
Ты увидел всё, что мы подготовили на данный момент! Можешь и дальше исследовать мир, общаться со зверушками и вести беседы!

Если заметишь ошибку, сообщи о ней через встроенную форму в главном меню или меню паузы.
